Will a list of licensees be publicly available? If not, will a list of licensees be available to other countries? If so which countries?

Will there be restrictions placed on licensees for how PMCs operate in foreign countries and where?

There will be restrictions placed upon PMCs in the UK that are involved in operations abroad. One of the major criticisms of PMCs is they are not subjected to the same international laws that national armed forces are. PMC organisations based in the UK and their employees will be held accountable for breaching international laws of war and/or international humanitarian law. In addition to this, allies of the UK will be strictly off limits in terms of warfare. Also, there are UN and EU embargoes on certain nations hiring, equipping or training PMCs, and these embargoes will be recognised and adhered to by UK PMCs.

Will PMC operations information be publicly available (where they are, what they're doing, etc)? Will this information be available to other countries and if so which ones?

All information on the operations of PMCs will be publicly available, as soon as the information can be released without compromising the actions of the PMC. What information will licensees need to provide to UK both for the initial license and for the upkeep?

There will be complete transparency between the organisation operating the PMC regarding the activities of the PMC. This is to ensure that all restrictions placed on UK based PMCs are being upheld. Failure to do so will mean a revocation of the license and a ban from reapplication.
